name: Making AI Work
title: ETAI Summit and Conclave 2026 - Making AI Work | ET Enterprise AI

design.notes: What the editor's theme controls act on. headingFontVar = the variable most headings read — unlike TECH500 this design has no separate '-v2' variant, every heading reads --heading-font-family (Plus Jakarta Sans) directly, already set on <body>. headings/buttons/cards = selectors for the heading, corner-radius controls. swatches = theme colours offered besides the template's own.

body.class: microsite product_microsite heading-style-3 color_white web_view_ et_enterpriseai single-header
body.classNotes: single-header is added at runtime by ET's header script on the live page, same as TECH500.

content.notes: How Create Event's content fills this template (editor-fill.js has the rule reference). from = a Create Event library id (step 3) or event (step 1). Two sections needed new LIBRARY entries added to create-event.html because nothing existing fit their real, event-specific content: 'key-topic' (the live page's own 'Key Discussion Points' graphic) is a verbatim match for the EXISTING 'priorities' library (same name, same shape) — no new entry needed there, just reused it. 'who-enter' ('Four Questions the Enterprise Now Has to Answer') had no existing fit, so a new 'keyquestions' library entry (shape 'columns', same t/d fields) was added. Both are genuine, event-specific content, not publisher boilerplate, so neither was left static. 'glimpses_event' (Previous Edition photos) maps to the EXISTING 'glimpses' library, but only for show/hide: Create Event's gallery shape only ever collects a photo COUNT, never real image uploads (case 'gallery' in create-event.html), so there is no per-photo data content.map's list rule could fill — wiring 'from':'glimpses' with no fill rules still makes the section respond to the wizard (toggled off, it hides, same as every other toggle:true section), which is the most this existing shape can honestly deliver; the real 'Previous Edition 2025' photos stay as this template's own ported content. 'about-wrapper' (the 'Making AI Work' Manifesto) is left out of content.map entirely and deliberately: it's the publisher's own brand statement, the same copy regardless of which 'Making AI Work' event is running, exactly like TECH500's 'About ETCIO' — not event content a wizard field should own. The banner shows the event's own logo where the live site shows the Agentic Summit one; speaker cards show the user's own name/role/company text but keep ET's own default-face placeholder photo in every slot (Create Event's speaker tool never collects a photo) rather than keep the live page's real, named individuals' photos, which would otherwise end up captioned with an unrelated user's typed-in name. If the event's hero was built from an uploaded PSD banner (create-event.html's PSD import), its composite image replaces the banner's own background image too, same as TECH500.

layout.notes: Which sections an event's own narrative order can touch. pinStart/pinEnd never move — the hero always opens the page and Contact/the Manifesto publisher block always close it, matching the live site and the same spirit as TECH500's own pinEnd. Everything else is free for RevampCanvas.mount()'s sectionOrder option to resequence.

sectionsNotes: repeat = the section's repeating cards for the editor's Layout items: item = selector for one card (its parent is the list), label = what the list shows for it. 'our-speakers' sample cards show real, public previous-edition speaker names from the live page but ET's own default-face placeholder photo, not the real individuals' photos (see content.notes).
